mapper.select: /** slave-generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerCountByParam (일반회원관리 목록 총 갯수 조회) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OP_USER U INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON UD.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UD.USE_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE U.STATUS_CODE = 9

/** slave-generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerDetails (일반회원관리 상세 조회) */ SELECT A.user_id, A.login_id AS login_id, A.user_name AS user_name, A.email AS email, A.sbscrb_se_code, A.user_key, A.status_code, A.sbscrb_se_nm, A.created_date, A.login_date, A.post AS post, A.address AS address, A.address_detail AS address_detail, A.receive_email, A.receive_sms, A.phone_number AS phone_number, A.gender AS gender, A.birthday AS birthday, A.total_cntr_amt, A.total_cntr_blce_point FROM ( SELECT U.user_id, U.login_id, U.user_name, U.email, U.sbscrb_se_code, U.user_key, U.status_code, C.label AS sbscrb_se_nm, CASE WHEN IFNULL(U.created_date, '') != '' THEN DATE_FORMAT(U.created_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE '' END AS created_date, CASE WHEN IFNULL(U.login_date, '') != '' THEN DATE_FORMAT(U.login_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') ELSE '' END AS login_date, UD.post, UD.address, UD.address_detail, UD.receive_email, UD.receive_sms, UD.phone_number, UD.gender, UD.birthday, (SELECT SUM(cntr_amt) FROM G_CNTR WHERE user_id = U.user_id AND sttemnt_pay_de IS NOT NULL AND delete_at = 'N' AND cntr_sttus_code = '200') AS total_cntr_amt, (SELECT SUM(cntr_blce_point) FROM G_CNTR WHERE user_id = U.user_id AND sttemnt_pay_de IS NOT NULL AND delete_at = 'N' AND cntr_sttus_code = '200') AS total_cntr_blce_point FROM OP_USER U INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON UD.user_id = U.user_id AND UD.use_flag = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C ON C.code_type = 'SBSCRB_SE' AND C.use_yn = 'Y' AND C.language = 'ko' AND C.id = U.sbscrb_se_code WHERE U.status_code = 9 AND U.user_id = #{userId} ) A

/** slave-generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerCumulativeTotal (기부, 포인트 누적합계 정보 조회) */ SELECT TOTAL_CNTR_AMT , TOTAL_CNTR_POINT , TOTAL_CNTR_USE_POINT , (TOTAL_CNTR_POINT - TOTAL_CNTR_USE_POINT) AS TOTAL_CNTR_BLCE_POINT FROM ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_AMT),0) AS TOTAL_CNTR_AMT, IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_POINT), 0) AS TOTAL_CNTR_POINT, SUM(CNTR_BLCE_POINT) AS TOTAL_CNTR_BLCE_POINT, ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(A.CNTR_USE_POINT), 0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A LEFT OUTER JOIN G_CNTR B ON A.CNTR_SN = B.CNTR_SN AND B.DELETE_AT = 'N' WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.USE_SE_CODE = '1' ) AS TOTAL_CNTR_USE_POINT FROM G_CNTR WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' ) A

/** slave-generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerCntrCountByParam (기부내역 목록 갯수 조회) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM G_CNTR CN INNER JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON L.LOCGOV_CODE = CN.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE WHERE CN.USER_ID = #{userId} AND CN.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CN.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CN.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200'

/** slave-generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerCntrListByParam (기부내역 목록 조회) */
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CN.CNTR_DE,'%Y-%m-%d') AS CNTR_DE , CN.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE , L.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE AS CNTR_UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE , L.LOCGOV_NM AS CNTR_LOCGOV_NM , L.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM AS CNTR_UPPER_LOCGOV_NM , CN.CNTR_AMT , CN.CNTR_POINT , DATE_FORMAT(CN.STTEMNT_PAY_DE,'%Y-%m-%d') AS STTEMNT_PAY_DE , CN.ELCTRN_PAY_NO , CN.CNTR_PATH_CODE , C.LABEL AS CNTR_PATH_NM , OCC.DETAIL AS LINK_INSTT_NM FROM G_CNTR CN INNER JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON L.LOCGOV_CODE = CN.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C ON C.CODE_TYPE = 'CNTR_PATH' AND C.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C.ID = CN.CNTR_PATH_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE OCC ON OCC.CODE_TYPE = 'LINK_INSTT_CD' AND C.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND OCC.USE_YN = 'Y' AND OCC.ID = CN.LINK_INSTT_CD WHERE CN.USER_ID = #{userId} AND CN.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CN.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CN.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' ORDER BY CN.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC

/** slave-generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerPointListByParam (포인트 내역 목록 조회) */
SELECT POINT_TYPE, DATE_FORMAT(A.CNTR_DE,'%Y-%m-%d') AS CNTR_DE, L.LOCGOV_CODE AS CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, L.LOCGOV_NM AS CNTR_LOCGOV_NM, L.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE AS CNTR_UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE, L.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM AS CNTR_UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, A.CNTR_AMT, A.CNTR_POINT, A.CNTR_USE_POINT, (A.CURRENT_CNTR_POINT - A.CURRENT_CNTR_USE_POINT) AS CNTR_BLCE_POINT, A.ORDER_CODE FROM ( SELECT 'OCC' AS POINT_TYPE, CNTR_DE, CNTR_AMT, CNTR_POINT, CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, '' AS ORDER_CODE, '' AS CNTR_USE_POINT, ( SELECT SUM(CNTR_POINT) FROM G_CNTR A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID AND A.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND A.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND A.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' ) AS CURRENT_CNTR_POINT, ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT),0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID ) AS CURRENT_CNTR_USE_POINT, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, '' AS USE_SN FROM G_CNTR GC WHERE GC.USER_ID = #{userId} AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'USE' AS POINT_TYPE, POINT_USE_DE AS CNTR_DE, '' AS CNTR_AMT, '' AS CNTR_POINT, CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, ORDER_CODE, CNTR_USE_POINT, ( SELECT SUM(CNTR_POINT) FROM G_CNTR A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID AND A.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND A.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND A.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' ) AS CURRENT_CNTR_POINT, ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT),0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID ) AS CURRENT_CNTR_USE_POINT, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, USE_SN FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT GC WHERE GC.USER_ID = #{userId} ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON L.LOCGOV_CODE = A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE ORDER BY A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC, USE_SN DESC

/** slave-generalcustomer-mapper.getGeneralCustomerDetailsNotStatusCode (일반회원관리 상세 조회 - 상태코드 미적용) */ SELECT A.user_id, A.login_id AS login_id, A.user_name AS user_name, A.email AS email, A.sbscrb_se_code, A.user_key, A.status_code, A.mber_ci, A.sbscrb_se_nm, A.created_date, A.login_date, A.post AS post, A.address AS address, A.address_detail AS address_detail, A.receive_email, A.phone_number AS phone_number, A.gender AS gender, A.birthday AS birthday, A.total_cntr_amt, A.total_cntr_blce_point FROM ( SELECT U.user_id, U.login_id, U.user_name, U.email, U.sbscrb_se_code, U.user_key, U.status_code, U.mber_ci, C.label AS sbscrb_se_nm, CASE WHEN IFNULL(U.created_date, '') != '' THEN DATE_FORMAT(U.created_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE '' END AS created_date, CASE WHEN IFNULL(U.login_date, '') != '' THEN DATE_FORMAT(U.login_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') ELSE '' END AS login_date, UD.post, UD.address, UD.address_detail, UD.receive_email, UD.phone_number, UD.gender, UD.birthday, (SELECT SUM(cntr_amt) FROM G_CNTR WHERE user_id = U.user_id AND sttemnt_pay_de IS NOT NULL AND delete_at = 'N' AND cntr_sttus_code = '200') AS total_cntr_amt, (SELECT SUM(cntr_blce_point) FROM G_CNTR WHERE user_id = U.user_id AND sttemnt_pay_de IS NOT NULL AND delete_at = 'N' AND cntr_sttus_code = '200') AS total_cntr_blce_point FROM OP_USER U INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON UD.user_id = U.user_id AND UD.use_flag = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C ON C.code_type = 'SBSCRB_SE' AND C.use_yn = 'Y' AND C.language = 'ko' AND C.id = U.SBSCRB_SE_CODE WHERE U.user_id = #{userId} ) A

/** slave-generalcustomer-mapper.getCntrBlcePointList (잔여 포인트 조회) */ SELECT CNTR_SN, CNTR_POINT - (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT),0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.CNTR_SN = GC.CNTR_SN) AS CNTR_BLCE_POINT, USER_ID, PSITN_LOCGOV_CODE, CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE FROM G_CNTR GC WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IFNULL(CNTR_BLCE_POINT, 0) > 0 AND STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200'

/** slave-generalcustomer-mapper.selectTotalCntrAmt (당해년도 총 기부 금액) */ SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_AMT), 0) AS TOTAL_CNTR_AMT FROM G_CNTR WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND DELETE_AT = 'N' AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND DATE_FORMAT(STTEMNT_PAY_DE,'%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y')

/** slave-generalcustomer-mapper.userDeliveryList (배송지 목록) */ SELECT A.user_delivery_id ,A.user_id ,A.default_flag ,A.title ,A.user_name AS user_name ,A.mobile AS mobile ,A.phone AS phone ,A.address AS address ,A.address_detail AS address_detail FROM ( SELECT user_delivery_id ,user_id ,default_flag ,title ,user_name ,mobile ,phone ,address ,address_detail FROM OP_USER_DELIVERY WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) A ORDER BY A.default_flag DESC, A.user_delivery_id DESC
